// Independent re-capture for docs/rust-port/engines/codex-cli-protocol.md.
// Calls the real @openai/codex-sdk (from the Node checkout's node_modules, read only) with node itself as the
// "codex" program: node runs the script named `exec` in the working folder (the stub), which records what it got.
// Usage: node capture.mjs [name-part ...]
import fs from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import { pathToFileURL } from "node:url";
import childProcess from "node:child_process";

const SCRATCH = path.resolve(process.env.CAPTURE_SCRATCH);
const PROJECT = process.env.CAPTURE_PROJECT;
const RUNS = path.join(SCRATCH, "runs");
const OUT = path.join(SCRATCH, "out");
const STUB = path.join(SCRATCH, "stub", "exec");
const NODE = process.execPath;
const HOME_CWD = process.cwd();

// Nothing of the machine's own Tarsee or Codex is read or written: every folder Tarsee's modules look at is here.
process.env.TARSEE_STATE_DIR = path.join(SCRATCH, "state");
process.env.TARSEE_WORKSPACE_DIR = path.join(SCRATCH, "state", "workspace");
process.env.TARSEE_DATA_DIR = path.join(SCRATCH, "state", "data");
for (const k of Object.keys(process.env)) {
  if (/^(CODEX_|OPENAI_|OPENROUTER_|DEEPSEEK_|ANTHROPIC_|TARSEE_(?!STATE_DIR|WORKSPACE_DIR|DATA_DIR))/i.test(k)) delete process.env[k];
}

const sdkUrl = pathToFileURL(path.join(PROJECT, "node_modules/@openai/codex-sdk/dist/index.js")).href;
const { Codex } = await import(sdkUrl);
const tarsee = (rel) => import(pathToFileURL(path.join(PROJECT, rel)).href);

const want = process.argv.slice(2);
const wanted = (name) => !want.length || want.includes(name);
const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms));
const TID = "01a1c000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000cc";
const ev = (o) => JSON.stringify(o) + "\n";
const BASIC = ev({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: TID }) + ev({ type: "turn.started" })
  + ev({ type: "item.completed", item: { id: "item_0", type: "agent_message", text: "hi" } })
  + ev({ type: "turn.completed", usage: { input_tokens: 10, cached_input_tokens: 2, cache_write_input_tokens: 0, output_tokens: 3, reasoning_output_tokens: 1 } });

// Watch every process Node starts, so "was a process started at all" has an answer of its own.
const spawned = [];
const origSpawn = childProcess.ChildProcess.prototype.spawn;
childProcess.ChildProcess.prototype.spawn = function (options) {
  const r = origSpawn.call(this, options);
  spawned.push({ file: options.file, pid: this.pid, argc: options.args?.length, windowsHide: options.windowsHide ?? null, detached: options.detached ?? null, cwd: options.cwd ?? null, stdio: Array.isArray(options.stdio) ? options.stdio.map((s) => s?.type ?? s) : options.stdio, envPairsCount: options.envPairs?.length ?? null, killSignal: options.killSignal ?? null });
  return r;
};

const uncaught = [];
process.on("uncaughtException", (e) => { uncaught.push({ name: e?.name, message: e?.message, code: e?.code, syscall: e?.syscall }); });
process.on("unhandledRejection", (e) => { uncaught.push({ unhandledRejection: true, name: e?.name, message: e?.message, code: e?.code }); });

function prepare(name, plan) {
  const dir = path.join(RUNS, name);
  fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
  fs.copyFileSync(STUB, path.join(dir, "exec"));
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, "plan.json"), JSON.stringify(plan ?? { stdout: BASIC }));
  return dir;
}
const readJson = (f) => { try { return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8")); } catch { return null; } };
const readText = (f) => { try { return fs.readFileSync(f, "utf8"); } catch { return null; } };
const errOf = (e) => (e ? { name: e.name, message: e.message, code: e.code ?? null, cause: e.cause ? { name: e.cause.name, message: e.cause.message } : null } : null);

/** One call of the SDK, the way providers/codex.js makes it. */
async function sdkRun(name, { plan, codex = {}, thread = {}, resume = null, input = "hello", turn = {}, abort = null, stopReadingAfter = null, noOverride = false } = {}) {
  const dir = prepare(name, plan);
  process.chdir(dir);
  const before = spawned.length;
  const uncaughtBefore = uncaught.length;
  const ac = abort ? new AbortController() : null;
  if (abort === "pre") ac.abort();
  const yielded = [];
  let threw = null;
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const timing = {};
  try {
    const client = new Codex({ ...codex, ...(noOverride ? {} : { codexPathOverride: NODE }) });
    const th = resume ? client.resumeThread(resume, thread) : client.startThread(thread);
    const { events } = await th.runStreamed(input, { ...turn, ...(ac ? { signal: ac.signal } : {}) });
    for await (const e of events) {
      yielded.push({ atMs: Date.now() - t0, event: e });
      if (abort && abort !== "pre" && yielded.length === abort.afterEvents) {
        setTimeout(() => { timing.abortAtMs = Date.now() - t0; timing.stubAliveAtAbort = readText(path.join(dir, "alive.txt")); ac.abort(); }, abort.delayMs ?? 0);
      }
      if (stopReadingAfter && yielded.length === stopReadingAfter) { timing.stoppedReadingAtMs = Date.now() - t0; break; }
    }
    timing.threadIdAfter = th.id;
  } catch (e) { threw = e; }
  timing.endedAtMs = Date.now() - t0;
  await sleep(abort || stopReadingAfter ? 700 : 250);
  const aliveA = readText(path.join(dir, "alive.txt"));
  const gA = readText(path.join(dir, "grandchild-alive.txt"));
  await sleep(abort || stopReadingAfter ? 400 : 0);
  const aliveB = readText(path.join(dir, "alive.txt"));
  const gB = readText(path.join(dir, "grandchild-alive.txt"));
  process.chdir(HOME_CWD);
  const rec = readJson(path.join(dir, "record.json"));
  if (rec?.grandchildPid) { try { process.kill(rec.grandchildPid); } catch { /* gone */ } }
  return {
    name, dir, plan: plan ?? { stdout: BASIC },
    record: rec,
    yielded, threw: errOf(threw), timing,
    stub: { lastAliveMs: aliveB, stillBeating: aliveA !== aliveB, exitedAtMs: rec?.exitedAtMs ?? null },
    grandchild: rec?.grandchildPid ? { pid: rec.grandchildPid, stillBeating: gA !== gB, lastAliveMs: gB } : null,
    spawnedByNode: spawned.slice(before),
    uncaught: uncaught.slice(uncaughtBefore),
  };
}

function summarize(r, { envOption = undefined } = {}) {
  const rec = r.record;
  return {
    name: r.name,
    args: rec?.args ?? null,
    cwdIsCallerCwd: rec ? path.resolve(rec.cwd) === path.resolve(r.dir) : null,
    envNames: rec ? Object.keys(rec.env).sort() : null,
    env: rec?.env ?? null,
    stdin: rec ? { bytes: rec.stdin.bytes, text: rec.stdin.text, sha256: rec.stdin.sha256, chunks: rec.stdin.chunks, eofAtMs: rec.stdin.eofAtMs } : null,
    signals: rec?.signals ?? null,
    yielded: r.yielded,
    threw: r.threw,
    timing: r.timing,
    stub: r.stub,
    grandchild: r.grandchild,
    spawnedByNode: r.spawnedByNode,
    uncaught: r.uncaught,
    plan: r.plan,
    envOption,
  };
}
const write = (name, obj) => { fs.mkdirSync(OUT, { recursive: true }); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(OUT, `${name}.json`), JSON.stringify(obj, null, 1)); console.log(`wrote ${name}`); };

// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// T: Tarsee's own options (buildCodexOptions), given to the SDK exactly as providers/codex.js run() gives them.
// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
const { buildCodexOptions, instructionsLimit, capInstructions } = await tarsee("src/ai/providers/codex-options.js");

const SERVER_ENV = {
  PATH: process.env.PATH, SYSTEMROOT: process.env.SYSTEMROOT, TEMP: process.env.TEMP, COMSPEC: process.env.COMSPEC,
  FROM_SERVER: "kept",
  OPENAI_API_KEY: "sk-" + "server-openai", OPENROUTER_API_KEY: "sk-or-" + "server", DEEPSEEK_API_KEY: "sk-ds-" + "server", TARSEE_LOCAL_AI_KEY: "local-" + "server",
  CODEX_HOME: "X:/should/not/pass", CODEX_API_KEY: "should-not-pass", codex_lowercase: "should-not-pass", OPENAI_BASE_URL: "http://evil.test", Openai_Base_Url2: "kept-not-a-credential-name",
  ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: "should-not-pass", CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: "should-not-pass", CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: "should-not-pass",
  ENCRYPTION_KEY: "should-not-pass", SETUP_PASSWORD: "should-not-pass", TARSEE_API_TOKEN: "should-not-pass",
  TARSEE_PROVIDER_KEY: "should-not-pass", TARSEE_MCP_TOKEN: "should-not-pass", TARSEE_CHATGPT_ACCESS_TOKEN: "should-not-pass",
  TARSEE_OTHER: "kept", CODEX_INTERNAL_ORIGINATOR_OVERRIDE: "should-not-pass",
};
const STATE = path.join(SCRATCH, "state");
const WORKSPACE = path.join(SCRATCH, "state", "workspace");
const SKILLS = path.join(PROJECT, "src", "skills");
fs.mkdirSync(WORKSPACE, { recursive: true });

async function tarseeTurn(name, target, ctx, { resume = null, input = "hello", plan, signal = null } = {}) {
  let o;
  try { o = buildCodexOptions(target, { env: SERVER_ENV, stateDir: STATE, workspace: WORKSPACE, mcp: { url: "http://127.0.0.1:45123/mcp", token: "mcp-" + "token-value" }, turnMark: "0123456789abcdef01234567", ...ctx }); }
  catch (e) { return { name, refused: { name: e.name, code: e.code, message: e.message } }; }
  // providers/codex.js line: new Codex({ env: o.env, config: o.config, ...(o.apiKey ? { apiKey: o.apiKey } : {}), ...(codexPath ? { codexPathOverride: codexPath } : {}) })
  const r = await sdkRun(name, { plan, codex: { env: o.env, config: o.config, ...(o.apiKey ? { apiKey: o.apiKey } : {}) }, thread: o.threadOptions, resume, input });
  const s = summarize(r);
  s.tarsee = { target, home: o.home, apiKey: o.apiKey ?? null, config: o.config, threadOptions: o.threadOptions, envOptionNames: Object.keys(o.env).sort() };
  s.envNamesChildHasThatOptionLacks = s.envNames ? s.envNames.filter((n) => !(n in o.env)) : null;
  s.envNamesOptionHasThatChildLacks = s.envNames ? Object.keys(o.env).filter((n) => !s.envNames.includes(n)) : null;
  s.envValueDiffs = s.env ? Object.keys(o.env).filter((n) => s.env[n] !== o.env[n]).map((n) => ({ n, option: o.env[n], child: s.env[n] })) : null;
  return s;
}

if (wanted("t6")) {
  // The instructions cap, and whether what passes the cap can be started at all.
  const plain = "A".repeat(40 * 1024);
  const a = await tarseeTurn("t6a-cap-plain-win32", { providerId: "openai", model: "m" }, { key: "sk-" + "k", developerInstructions: plain });
  const quotes = "\"".repeat(40 * 1024);
  const b = await tarseeTurn("t6b-cap-all-quotes-win32", { providerId: "openai", model: "m" }, { key: "sk-" + "k", developerInstructions: quotes });
  const newlines = "line\n".repeat(8 * 1024);
  const c = await tarseeTurn("t6c-cap-many-newlines-win32", { providerId: "openai", model: "m" }, { key: "sk-" + "k", developerInstructions: newlines });
  const slim = (s) => ({
    refused: s.refused ?? null, threw: s.threw, spawnedByNode: s.spawnedByNode, uncaught: s.uncaught,
    instructionsBytesAfterCap: s.tarsee ? Buffer.byteLength(s.tarsee.config.developer_instructions) : null,
    developerInstructionsArgChars: s.args ? s.args.find((x) => x.startsWith("developer_instructions="))?.length : null,
    totalArgChars: s.args ? s.args.reduce((n, x) => n + x.length + 1, 0) : null,
    argCount: s.args?.length ?? null,
    yieldedCount: s.yielded?.length ?? null,
  });
  write("t6-instruction-caps", {
    instructionsLimit: { win32: instructionsLimit("win32"), linux: instructionsLimit("linux"), darwin: instructionsLimit("darwin") },
    capOf40KiBPlain: { win32: Buffer.byteLength(capInstructions(plain, instructionsLimit("win32"))), linux: Buffer.byteLength(capInstructions(plain, instructionsLimit("linux"))) },
    plain: slim(a), allQuotes: slim(b), manyNewlines: slim(c),
  });
}

if (wanted("a6")) {
  const cases = {
    crlf_loneCR_noFinalNewline: ev({ type: "a" }).replace("\n", "\r\n") + JSON.stringify({ type: "b" }) + "\r" + JSON.stringify({ type: "c" }) + "\n" + JSON.stringify({ type: "d" }),
    u2028_inside_a_string: ev({ type: "item.completed", item: { id: "item_0", type: "agent_message", text: "before\u2028after\u2029end" } }) + ev({ type: "z" }),

    json_but_not_object: ev({ type: "a" }) + "42\n\"str\"\nnull\n" + ev({ type: "b" }),

    turn_completed_no_usage: ev({ type: "turn.completed" }),
    long_line_300k: ev({ type: "item.completed", item: { id: "item_0", type: "agent_message", text: "x".repeat(300000) } }) + ev({ type: "b" }),
  };
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, stdout] of Object.entries(cases)) {
    const r = await sdkRun(`a6-${k}`, { plan: { stdout }, codex: { env: {} } });
    out[k] = { stdout: stdout.length > 500 ? `${stdout.slice(0, 120)}... (${stdout.length} chars)` : stdout, yielded: r.yielded.map((y) => (JSON.stringify(y.event).length > 300 ? { type: y.event.type, textLength: y.event.item?.text?.length } : y.event)), threw: r.threw, stubLastAliveMs: r.stub.lastAliveMs, stubExitedAtMs: r.stub.exitedAtMs, uncaught: r.uncaught };
  }
  // a split multi-byte character across two writes
  const snow = Buffer.from(ev({ type: "item.completed", item: { id: "item_0", type: "agent_message", text: "☃😀" } }), "utf8");
  const cut = snow.indexOf(Buffer.from("☃")) + 1;
  const r = await sdkRun("a6-split-utf8", { plan: { stdout: [{ base64: snow.subarray(0, cut).toString("base64") }, { base64: snow.subarray(cut).toString("base64"), delayMs: 150 }] }, codex: { env: {} } });
  out.split_utf8_across_writes = { yielded: r.yielded.map((y) => y.event), threw: r.threw };
  write("a6-stdout-reading", out);
}
if (wanted("a7")) {
  const out = {};
  const cases = {
    nonzero_after_events: { stdout: ev({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: TID }) + ev({ type: "turn.failed", error: { message: "boom" } }), stderr: "Reading prompt from stdin...\n", exitCode: 1 },

}
if (wanted("a8")) {
  const plan = { stdout: [{ text: ev({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: TID }) + ev({ type: "turn.started" }) }, { text: ev({ type: "item.started", item: { id: "item_0", type: "command_execution", command: "sleep", aggregated_output: "", exit_code: null, status: "in_progress" } }), delayMs: 100 }, { text: ev({ type: "late" }), delayMs: 3000 }], sleepMsBeforeExit: 20000, spawnChild: true };
  const r = await sdkRun("a8-abort-mid-turn", { plan, codex: { env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, SYSTEMROOT: process.env.SYSTEMROOT } }, abort: { afterEvents: 3, delayMs: 300 } });
  write("a8-abort-mid-turn", summarize(r));
}
if (wanted("a9")) {
  const r = await sdkRun("a9-signal-already-aborted", { plan: { stdout: BASIC, sleepMsBeforeExit: 5000 }, codex: { env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, SYSTEMROOT: process.env.SYSTEMROOT } }, abort: "pre" });
  const s = summarize(r);
  s.recordFileExists = fs.existsSync(path.join(r.dir, "record.json"));
  write("a9-signal-already-aborted", s);
}
if (wanted("a10")) {
  const plan = { stdout: [{ text: ev({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: TID }) }, { text: ev({ type: "turn.started" }), delayMs: 200 }], sleepMsBeforeExit: 20000, spawnChild: true };
  const r = await sdkRun("a10-caller-stops-reading", { plan, codex: { env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, SYSTEMROOT: process.env.SYSTEMROOT } }, stopReadingAfter: 1 });
  write("a10-caller-stops-reading", summarize(r));
}
if (wanted("a11")) {
  const out = {};
  for (const [k, n] of Object.entries({ small_5_bytes: 5, big_2MB: 2 * 1024 * 1024 })) {
    const r = await sdkRun(`a11-exits-before-reading-${k}`, { plan: { exitWithoutReadingStdin: true, stderr: "error: unexpected argument '--bogus' found\n", exitCode: 2 }, codex: { env: {} }, input: "p".repeat(n) });
    await sleep(300);
    out[k] = { yielded: r.yielded, threw: r.threw, uncaughtInTheCallersProcess: uncaught.slice(-3), stubExitedAtMs: r.stub.exitedAtMs };
  }
  write("a11-program-exits-before-reading-stdin", out);
}
if (wanted("a12")) {
  const dir = prepare("a12-missing", {});
  process.chdir(dir);
  let threw = null; const yielded = [];
  const u0 = uncaught.length;
  try {
    const client = new Codex({ env: {}, codexPathOverride: path.join(dir, "no-such-codex.exe") });
    const { events } = await client.startThread().runStreamed("hello");
    for await (const e of events) yielded.push(e);
  } catch (e) { threw = e; }
  await sleep(200);
  process.chdir(HOME_CWD);
  write("a12-program-missing", { yielded, threw: errOf(threw), threwErrno: threw?.errno, threwSyscall: threw?.syscall, threwPath: threw?.path ? "<the path given>" : null, uncaught: uncaught.slice(u0) });
}
if (wanted("a13")) {
  const prompt = "Line one\r\nLine two\n\u0000nul? no: " + "é☃😀".repeat(20000) + "\n\ntrailing spaces   \n\n";
  const r = await sdkRun("a13-long-unicode-prompt", { codex: { env: {} }, input: prompt.replace("\u0000", "") });
  const want2 = Buffer.from(prompt.replace("\u0000", ""), "utf8");
  write("a13-long-unicode-prompt", { promptChars: prompt.length - 1, promptUtf8Bytes: want2.length, promptSha256: crypto.createHash("sha256").update(want2).digest("hex"), stdinBytes: r.record?.stdin.bytes, stdinSha256: r.record?.stdin.sha256, same: r.record?.stdin.sha256 === crypto.createHash("sha256").update(want2).digest("hex"), chunks: r.record?.stdin.chunks?.length, threw: r.threw });
}
if (wanted("a14")) {
  const a = await sdkRun("a14-empty-string", { codex: { env: {} }, input: "" });
  const b = await sdkRun("a14b-only-pictures", { codex: { env: {} }, input: [{ type: "local_image", path: "x.png" }] });
  const c = await sdkRun("a14c-empty-text-items", { codex: { env: {} }, input: [{ type: "text", text: "" }, { type: "text", text: "" }, { type: "local_image", path: "x.png" }] });
  const d = await sdkRun("a14d-lone-surrogate", { codex: { env: {} }, input: "a\ud83db" });
  write("a14-empty-and-odd-prompts", Object.fromEntries([["emptyString", a], ["onlyPictures", b], ["twoEmptyTexts", c], ["loneSurrogate", d]].map(([k, r]) => [k, { args: r.record?.args, stdinBytes: r.record?.stdin.bytes, stdinBase64: r.record?.stdin.base64, eofAtMs: r.record?.stdin.eofAtMs, threw: r.threw }])));
}
if (wanted("a15")) {
  // Lines already written when the abort fires, and the program printing more after it (it cannot: it is dead on Windows).
  const many = Array.from({ length: 200 }, (_, i) => ev({ type: "n", i })).join("");
  const plan = { stdout: [{ text: ev({ type: "thread.started", thread_id: TID }) }, { text: many, delayMs: 200 }], sleepMsBeforeExit: 20000 };
  const r = await sdkRun("a15-abort-during-burst", { plan, codex: { env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, SYSTEMROOT: process.env.SYSTEMROOT } }, abort: { afterEvents: 2, delayMs: 0 } });
  write("a15-abort-during-burst", { yieldedCount: r.yielded.length, lastYielded: r.yielded.at(-1), threw: r.threw, timing: r.timing, stub: r.stub });
}
if (wanted("a16")) {
  // Two turns on one Thread object: the second one resumes by itself.
  const dir = prepare("a16-two-turns-one-thread", { stdout: BASIC });
  process.chdir(dir);
  const client = new Codex({ env: {}, codexPathOverride: NODE });
  const th = client.startThread({ model: "m", threadSource: "user" });
  const idBefore = th.id;
  for await (const _ of (await th.runStreamed("one")).events) { /* drain */ }
  const first = readJson(path.join(dir, "record.json"));
  for await (const _ of (await th.runStreamed("two")).events) { /* drain */ }
  const second = readJson(path.join(dir, "record.json"));
  process.chdir(HOME_CWD);
  write("a16-two-turns-one-thread", { idBefore, idAfter: th.id, firstArgs: first.args, secondArgs: second.args, differentPids: first.pid !== second.pid });
}
if (wanted("a17")) {
  // What the SDK refuses before it starts anything.
  const out = {};
  const tryIt = async (k, codex, thread = {}, turn = {}) => {
    const before = spawned.length;
    const r = await sdkRun(`a17-${k}`, { codex: { env: {}, ...codex }, thread, turn });
    out[k] = { threw: r.threw, started: spawned.length > before, args: r.record?.args ?? null };
  };
  await tryIt("null_value", { config: { a: { b: null } } });
  await tryIt("nan", { config: { n: NaN } });
  await tryIt("infinity", { config: { n: Infinity } });
  await tryIt("empty_key", { config: { "": 1 } });
  await tryIt("empty_key_in_inline_table", { config: { a: [{ "": 1 }] } });
  await tryIt("function_value", { config: { f: () => 1 } });
  await tryIt("bigint_value", { config: { f: 10n } });
  await tryIt("config_is_array", { config: [1] });
  await tryIt("config_is_string", { config: "x=1" });
  await tryIt("output_schema_not_object", {}, {}, { outputSchema: [1] });
  await tryIt("empty_config_object", { config: {} });
  await tryIt("date_value", { config: { d: new Date(0) } });
  write("a17-refused-by-the-sdk", out);
}

console.log("done; uncaught so far:", JSON.stringify(uncaught));
process.exit(0);
